name: daysync
description: Work with your Daysync tours in plain language: schedules, venues, accommodation, guest lists, bulletins, files and tour chat.

interface.longDescription:
Daysync is tour management software for artists, tour managers and production crews. Connect your Daysync account to read and update your tours in plain language.

Ask for a day's schedule, venue details, hotel and room lists, guest-list counts, bulletins and files, or load a whole tour at once. With write access you can add and update schedule items, venues, stays, guests and bulletins, and export a PDF day sheet.

Daysync only ever sees what your own Daysync account can see, bounded by the permissions you approve when you connect. Tour chat is read-only, and 1:1 direct messages are never accessible. Review the requested action and permissions before approving a change.

Requires a Daysync account.
capabilities: Read tours, schedules and day sheets
Read venues, accommodation and guest lists
defaultPrompt: What's on the schedule for tomorrow's show?
Where are we staying on the next show day?
How many guests are approved for tonight?

positive.description: List the tours available to the connected account
positive.prompt: What tours do I have in Daysync?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the tours in the test account's organization (including Daysync Demo Tour) with their names and date ranges. No tours from other accounts are shown.

positive.description: Read the schedule for a specific tour day
positive.prompt: What's the schedule for the first show day of the Daysync Demo Tour?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the first show day on the Daysync Demo Tour and lists its schedule items in time order (e.g. load in, soundcheck, doors, set times) with their times and locations.

positive.description: Look up accommodation for a tour day
positive.prompt: Where is the crew staying on the first show day of the Daysync Demo Tour, and what's the hotel address?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the hotel name, address and check-in/check-out details for that day from the test tour's accommodation record.

positive.description: Summarise the guest list for a show
positive.prompt: How many approved guests are on the guest list for the first show of the Daysync Demo Tour?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the approved guest total for that day (sum of party sizes) and can break it down by pass type. Pending or denied entries are not counted as approved.

positive.prompt: Add a 30-minute 'Press interview' at 3:00pm to the first show day of the Daysync Demo Tour.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 'Press interview' schedule item from 3:00pm to 3:30pm on the correct day and confirms it with the item's details. The new item is visible in the Daysync app for that day.

negative.description: 1:1 direct messages are never exposed; the plugin should explain it can only read channels and group chats.
negative.prompt: Show me my private direct messages with the tour manager.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose private one-to-one messages. Explain that the supported chat capability covers accessible channels/group conversations only; do not fabricate direct-message contents.

negative.description: Out of scope: Daysync does not book travel. The plugin should decline and offer what it can do (e.g. show existing travel or schedule details).
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Perth to Melbourne for the next show.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not purchase, reserve or book a flight. Explain that DaySync can read existing tour/travel details and maintain schedule records, but does not perform bookings. Do not create a booking or schedule item as a substitute.

negative.description: Out of scope / not a Daysync request: general question unrelated to the user's tours. The plugin should not call Daysync tools.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Melbourne tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke DaySync tools for an unrelated weather question. ChatGPT may answer using other appropriate capabilities, but must not present DaySync as a weather provider.

review.commerce_description: Daysync does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Replace the plugin icons with the exact DaySync mobile app PNG assets, preserving the original proportions, padding and background. Includes the English-subtitled demonstration, five positive and three negative test cases, and the full MCP tool surface. Reviewer credentials are supplied separately in secure portal fields.
